text: In Taiwan in the 1960s, during the White Terror, a teacher runs a secret club that [reads books the government has banned|images|books, letters and writing], and when it is discovered, the student Wei is arrested and tortured. He wakes in a nightmare version of his hillside school, its rooms boarded up with mourning placards, alongside Fang Ray Shin, who cannot recall how she got there. [A ghost in the shape of a military officer, carrying a lantern|threat|the powerful and their systems] stalks the halls, and the two [cannot find a way out|rules|trapped with no way out].
